testimonials.quote: Daniel took our releases from a nervous Friday-night ritual to something nobody thinks about any more. When production was on fire he was the calmest person on the call, and he wrote the whole thing up the next morning.
testimonials.name: Serge Kamgang

testimonials.quote: Daniel treated security as part of the daily job, not a project for later. Patching, SELinux, firewall rules: he scripted all of it, so our hundred-plus servers stayed consistent. And when something broke at 2 a.m., he was already on the call.
testimonials.name: Joselyne

testimonials.quote: We had to move off RHEL 7 and migrate our Elasticsearch clusters to OpenSearch without taking anything down. Daniel planned both carefully, and our users never noticed. The juniors on my team also came out of working with him as better engineers.
testimonials.name: Benjamin Smith

story: I started as a Linux systems administrator keeping 100+ servers running for a national tax authority, and I’ve been automating the repetitive work ever since. Today I design AWS infrastructure as code, build CI/CD pipelines teams trust, and run Kubernetes platforms with monitoring that pages the right person for the right reason.
I care about security from the first commit, cloud bills someone has actually read, and documentation the next engineer can follow at 3 a.m.
